Set the default premount duration in seconds for timed components in the Studio. Defaults to 0 in v4 and 2 in v5. Must be a finite, non-negative number. The duration is converted to frames using the composition FPS and rounded to the nearest frame. An explicit `premountFor` prop takes precedence. Does not affect rendering. In the Player, use the `defaultPremountInSeconds` prop instead.

## CLI flag

```text
--default-premount-in-seconds <value>
```

The following CLI commands accept this option:

- [`remotion studio`](/docs/cli/studio)

## Config file

```ts twoslash title="remotion.config.ts"
import {Config} from '@remotion/cli/config';
// ---cut---
Config.setDefaultPremountInSeconds(2);
```
